newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Bendigo shares shine on gold find.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Bendigo shares shine on gold find.

text.p: Shares in gold explorer Bendigo Mining NL jumped more than 20 percent to an intraday high of 24 cents following the announcement of new resources at its tenements at Bendigo in Victoria, brokers said.

The company said on Monday it had discovered and defined resources totalling 300,000 ounces of gold on its tenements with the resource made up of both open-pit and underground mining mineralisation totalling 4.0 million tonnes at an average grade of 2.3 grams per tonne gold.
"They've jumped on the strength of the report. There is no other news about," said a Melbourne broker.
Bendigo said a great deal of analytical work was required before a confident understanding of the sampling and assaying techniques required for the district could be obtained.
By 3.40 p.m. (0540 GMT), Bendigo shares were four cents up on Friday's close at 23 cents on turnover of 331,000 shares.
